correctness.rationale: Direct substitution at an isosceles apex gives an affine defect in \(\lambda\). A collapsing right triangle gives \(\varepsilon F_\lambda\to(2-\lambda)(1-q)\), proving the upper obstruction. Strict boundary negativity passes to interior points by continuity. The saved checker verifies the radical arithmetic and explicit finite representatives.

value.rationale: Liu explicitly made the parameter interval part of an open geometric inequality. An exact obstruction to extending that interval is therefore intrinsically motivated. The lower constant comes from optimizing the simplest symmetry/boundary family rather than an arbitrary numerical slice, while the upper family proves that the conjectured endpoint 2 is globally unavoidable. This guides any future sharp formulation even though it does not prove the conjecture itself.
